title: Occurrence — structural placeholder
description: An exact attributable occurrence, without converting evidence of one occurrence into another.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

occurrence.description: Exact occurrence claimed, distinguishing exposure, delivery, receipt, admission, and other events.

locality.description: Locality in which the claim is held; not another Locality's inferred interior.

attribution.description: Attributable ground of the occurrence claim.

scope.description: Exact target and relation supported by the claim.

time.description: Supported temporal boundary or ordering; no invented precision.

evidence.description: Support with declared object, method, scope, time, basis, result, and effect ceiling.

carrier.description: Carrier kept distinct from the occurrence.

record.description: Preserved account kept distinct from the occurrence.

uncertainty.description: Unsupported or unresolved details retained without forced resolution.
